raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1 defines two KV cache layouts. The checkpoint's own `inference/model.py` and DeepSeek's DeepInfer (`V41_FORMAT`) agree on both:

- **Window/SWA KV:** all 512 values, RoPE part included, in e4m3 blocks of 32 with UE8M0 scales.
- **Ratio-1/2 compressed KV:** e2m1 blocks of 16 with e4m3 scales.

SGLang already has both layouts as `KVLayout.V41` and `V41_FP4`, and its writers support them. However, `select_dsv4_kv_layout` allows them only on SM100. SM120 / SM121 (RTX 50, RTX PRO Blackwell, DGX Spark) therefore always run the V4 layout, which keeps RoPE in bf16 and uses FP8 blocks of 64.

FlashInfer 0.7.2 already ships SM120 kernels that read both V4.1 caches (`kv_scale_format="ue8m0_g32"`, `extra_kv_fp4`).

## Modifications

- `select_dsv4_kv_layout`: return V41 on SM12x when `SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT=v41` and `SGLANG_SM120_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=flashinfer` (the default backend). The default layout stays `v4`, so nothing changes unless the variable is set.
- `flash_mla_with_kvcache_sm120`: a 528-byte main cache goes to FlashInfer's `SparseMLASm120Wrapper`, with:
  - `kv_scale_format="ue8m0_g32"`;
  - `extra_kv_fp4` set for a 288-byte extra cache;
  - one wrapper per (extra format, device).

  The cache is read in place: FlashInfer takes the page size at run time, so the 256 → 64 page split the V4 path needs is skipped.
- `SGLANG_SM120_V41_PRECISION`, default `bf16`, selects FlashInfer's full-BF16 route: bf16 Q and P, exact on-chip dequantization, and fp32 softmax and merge, as the reference computes. `default` selects FlashInfer's MXFP8 route.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (1017 checkpoint) on 2× RTX 5070 Ti (SM120), TP2.

- **Writers:** the V41 / V41_FP4 writers match the reference's `act_quant` / `fp4_act_quant`. 0 of 2,097,152 values differ in each.
- **Attention, single op:** compared against torch attention over SGLang's own dequantization of the same pages.

  | Route | Error |
  |---|---|
  | full-BF16 | 0.2–0.3% |
  | FlashInfer's default MXFP8 | 3.2–3.9% |

- **Layer 0's attention output** against the reference implementation, run layer by layer: 3.8% off with the V4 layout, 1.0% with V41.
- **Mean NLL** on 24 × 480-token pieces:

  | Run | Mean NLL |
  |---|---|
  | reference | 2.594 |
  | V4 layout | 2.596 |
  | V41 layout | 2.590 |

  The per-piece SE is about 0.007.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Decode attention per call under a CUDA graph (1 token, 32 heads):

| Inputs | V4 layout (page split) | V41 layout |
|---|---|---|
| 128 window positions | 16.1 µs | 10.0 µs |
| 128 window + 512 FP4 compressed positions | 18.0 µs | 11.3 µs |

A compressed-KV token takes 288 bytes instead of 584. The 35K-token prefill is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

@@ -580,6 +596,80 @@ def _split_kv_pages_to_64(
     )
 
 
+_V41_MAIN_BYTES = 528  # KVLayout.V41: 512 fp8 + 16 ue8m0 scales (one per 32 values)
+_V41_FP4_BYTES = 288  # KVLayout.V41_FP4: 256 e2m1 bytes + 32 e4m3 scales (one per 16)
+_V41_WRAPPERS = {}
+
+
+def _v41_wrapper(extra_fp4: bool, device):
+    """One FlashInfer SM120 sparse-MLA wrapper per (extra cache format, device).
+
+    SGLANG_SM120_V41_PRECISION: "bf16" (default) runs the full-BF16 route, which
+    computes as DeepSeek's reference does: bf16 Q and P operands, the cache
+    dequantized exactly on chip, fp32 softmax and split merge. "default" is
+    FlashInfer's MXFP8 route (Q and P rounded to FP8).
+    """
+    precision = envs.SGLANG_SM120_V41_PRECISION.get()
+    key = (extra_fp4, precision, device)
+    wrapper = _V41_WRAPPERS.get(key)
+    if wrapper is None:
+        from flashinfer.mla import SparseMLASm120Wrapper
+
+        wrapper = SparseMLASm120Wrapper(
+            kv_scale_format="ue8m0_g32",
+            extra_kv_fp4=extra_fp4,
+            compute_precision=precision,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        _V41_WRAPPERS[key] = wrapper
+    return wrapper
+
+
+def _flash_mla_flashinfer_v41(
+    q,
+    k_cache,
+    indices,
+    topk_length,
+    attn_sink,
+    head_dim_v,
+    softmax_scale,
+    extra_k_cache,
+    extra_indices,
+    extra_topk_length,
+):
+    """Sparse MLA over a KVLayout.V41 main cache, decode and prefill alike."""
+    q2 = q.squeeze(1) if q.ndim == 4 else q
+    num_tokens, num_heads, _ = q2.shape
+    kv_u8 = k_cache if k_cache.dtype == torch.uint8 else k_cache.view(torch.uint8)
+    idx = indices.squeeze(1) if indices.dim() == 3 else indices
+    extra_u8 = None
+    extra_idx = None
+    if extra_k_cache is not None:
+        extra_u8 = (
+            extra_k_cache
+            if extra_k_cache.dtype == torch.uint8
+            else extra_k_cache.view(torch.uint8)
+        )
+        extra_idx = (
+            extra_indices.squeeze(1) if extra_indices.dim() == 3 else extra_indices
+        )
+    extra_fp4 = extra_u8 is not None and extra_u8.shape[-1] == _V41_FP4_BYTES
+    output = q2.new_empty((num_tokens, num_heads, head_dim_v), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    _v41_wrapper(extra_fp4, q2.device).run(
+        q2,
+        kv_u8,
+        idx,
+        output,
+        softmax_scale,
+        topk_length=topk_length,
+        attn_sink=attn_sink,
+        extra_kv_cache=extra_u8,
+        extra_indices=extra_idx,
+        extra_topk_length=extra_topk_length,
+    )
+    return (output.unsqueeze(1), None)
+
+
 def _flash_mla_flashinfer(
     q,
     k_cache,

     SGLANG_DSV4_COMPRESSED_KV_LAYOUT = EnvStr("auto")

     # unified_kv only: split the pool into an fp8 nope pool plus a parallel

@@ -228,10 +228,25 @@ def select_dsv4_kv_layout() -> Tuple[KVLayout, Optional[str]]:
                 "which reads the block-split v41 layout"
             )
         return KVLayout.V41, option
+    # SM120 / SM121 read the V4.1 layouts through FlashInfer's SM120 sparse MLA
+    # (flash_mla_sm120.py); "auto" still keeps V4 there.
+    is_sm12x_flashinfer = (
+        torch.cuda.is_available()
+        and torch.version.cuda is not None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 12

+    )
     if mode == "auto" and not is_sm100:
         return KVLayout.V4, None
-    assert is_sm100, "the V4.1 KV cache layouts need an SM100 / SM103 GPU"
-    return (KVLayout.V41_NEW if mode == "v41_new" else KVLayout.V41), option
+    if mode == "v41_new":
+        # the token-interleaved layout is read by SM100 / SM103 FlashMLA only
+        assert is_sm100, "the v41_new KV cache layout needs an SM100 / SM103 GPU"
+        return KVLayout.V41_NEW, option
+    assert is_sm100 or is_sm12x_flashinfer, (
+        "the V4.1 KV cache layouts need an SM100 / SM103 GPU, or SM120 / SM121 "
